train_curves._units: x = training tokens (B), y = validation NLL; truncated at WSD cooldown start (as in paper)

mem_vs_ppl_1p7B._source: PDF vector extraction of paper imgs/mem_vs_ppl_norm.pdf (no generating script/data found on clariden); KB values are exact integers, ppl accurate to ~1e-3
mem_vs_ppl_1p7B._units: kv_kb_per_token = KV cache per token (KB, CPLM incl. copy keys), ppl = FinePDFs perplexity

window_sweep_135M._columns: [window, memory_at_2k_tokens_MB, ppl]  (paper x-axis = 'Memory at 2k Tokens (MB)'; full = single point, window n/a)

rolling16k._source: PDF vector extraction of paper imgs/rolling16k_5000_{ppl,gate,sink}.pdf (no generating script/data found on clariden). 1.7B models, 5000 FinePDFs docs x 16k tokens; Full/Hybrid with YaRN x4
rolling16k._units: pos = token position (bin centres, 125-token bins); ppl; copy = mean p(<copy>); sink = mean sink prob
rolling16k._note: vanilla ppl values above ~14.7 were clipped at the top of the paper axis and are set to null (Full vanilla diverges past ~7k; curve stops there)

niah._source: text extraction of the cell annotations in paper imgs/niah_heatmap.pdf (no 1.7B NIAH result JSON found on clariden; eval/results_niah/ only holds 135M/360M/CPT runs). Cells are integer-rounded %

docs_dropped._note: vanilla_lastlayer = control: vanilla model that reaches the documents only via last-layer KV

memory_mb_per_doc._note: SW vanilla bar is 0 (not drawn): only the 256-token window is cached

nullspace._units: pos = sequence position (of 2048); values = lost gradient (%); lo/hi = mean -/+ 1 std

spamlang._units: acc = final top-1 accuracy (fraction), loss = final loss

induction._note: 1.7B models; heads = # induction heads with score > 0.3 (paper panel 'induction_sweep_heads_0p3'); map_T128 = Full backbone only, [layer][head]

gsm8k_passk._source: PDF vector extraction of paper imgs/gsm8k_passk.pdf (no GSM8K pass@k data/script found on clariden); 1.7B SFT models, values in % (accurate to ~0.05)
